maturity_slice: Reconcile Policy Fields and Observation Scheduler

acceptance_criteria.statement: AC1 Reconcile modes persist on environments and deployment units.
AC2 Disabled policy prevents scheduled observations.
AC3 Non-disabled policies observe and update drift without remediation.

rollout_gates.gate: Observation scheduler selects only due rows.
Disabled-mode environments remain quiet during rollout.

rollback_criteria.criterion: Set default_reconcile_mode to disabled for affected environments.
Stop observation scheduler if policy selection metrics diverge.
